study_type: Retrospective empirical probabilistic forecasting with a held-out chronological evaluation; not a causal study or preregistered study
research_question: Does an alternative finite-threshold dependence shape add reproducible joint warning skill beyond the same single-zone recalibrated forecasts and a competitive weather-dependent Gaussian copula?
main_contribution: Controlled predictive-component evidence about incremental finite-event probability and monitoring performance with documented marginal-calibration uncertainty; ideal marginal calibration is examined separately in explicitly labelled simulations
claim_boundaries: Provider-reported residual electricity load is not outage, loss-of-load, EENS, actual reserve deficit or an operational adequacy probability
C3 and C5 share R(X) and theoretical conditional pairwise Kendall tau; they do not necessarily share physical Pearson correlations
A finite t degree of freedom is not proof of asymptotic physical tail dependence or an unobserved meteorological mechanism
A fixed physical seasonal threshold can lie in the central part of a weather-conditional marginal distribution
Measured skill and error rates do not certify real operator utility or historical production availability

Development calibration qualification was precision_insufficient; no supported material departure does not prove conditional equivalence. European data do not alone identify a physical tail mechanism after perfectly calibrated margins.
Ideal-marginal simulations, if executed, identify component behavior under their stated data-generating assumptions and do not establish perfect European calibration.

electricity.target: provider-reported load minus wind generation minus solar generation, in MW

providers.BE: Elia load/wind/PV, including source-specific Sotel footprint

native_resolution.FR: two original half-hour readings per UTC hour
native_resolution.BE: four original quarter-hour readings per UTC hour

electricity.boundary_policy: Provider boundaries and self-consumption definitions are documented; perfectly identical gross-demand boundaries are not asserted
electricity.primary_night_PV_rule: Only flagged originally missing Belgian 23:45 local quarter-hours with zero original neighbors and conservative solar-elevation bound below -6 degrees are assigned zero
electricity.missing_unqualified_components: Retain NaN; no interpolation or silent zero filling

history_and_selection.historical_exploration_disclosure: 2021 numerical, extrapolation, rolling calibration and lag diagnostics informed the recorded final four-candidate strategy; 2021 is not a blinded evaluation
history_and_selection.marginal_choice: The completed daily_matched4 development comparison selected additive raw60/daily-G60 for lowest marginal truncated-IQS in both development years; preserve the original selector precision_insufficient and chosen=null, together with a separate explicit predictive decision and its evidence boundary
history_and_selection.marginal_selection_target: Marginal normalized truncated integrated quantile score and recorded calibration evidence, never joint-event score
history_and_selection.Gaussian_choice: Actual 2023 q90 at-least-two equal-complete-day Brier among lean/rich weather bases crossed with l2 0.001, 0.01, 0.1; tie within 1e-10 favors fewer features then larger l2
history_and_selection.selection_adjusted_test: All strategy choices are fixed before test event labels and forecast scores are examined
history_and_selection.test_preinspection_scope: Electricity source QA, missingness, units, alignment and conditional nighttime reconstruction flags were inspected; 2024-2025 joint event labels, forecasting comparisons and model scores were not inspected before final strategy locking
history_and_selection.test_outcomes_inspected_false_semantics: Legacy code field denotes no prior test-event or forecast-score inspection at freeze; it does not claim no previous access to source-quality observations or flags
history_and_selection.retrospective_forecast_semantics: Forward parameter fits respect target cutoffs conditional on the development-selected strategy; these are not archived historically issued operational forecasts
history_and_selection.marginal_qualification: Approximate recalibration with uncertainty; the independent predictive decision does not certify all conditional margins equivalent or remove the observed-calibration limitation
history_and_selection.Gaussian_numerical_execution_repair: After rich/l2=0.001 reached the original 400-iteration cap without convergence, the complete unchanged 24 candidate-quarter development grid was restarted at a common 2000 cap before final selection or held-out scores; objective, tolerances, features, penalties and selection rule unchanged. This is an execution repair, not a methodological innovation.

weather.initialization: 00:00 UTC on target day minus one
weather.issue: 12:00 UTC on target day minus one
weather.target: All 24 hourly intervals of the next UTC day
weather.availability_assumption: Initialization plus 12 hours; original public first-arrival timestamps are not exhaustively certified
weather.market_boundary: Issue is after the standard day-ahead auction; no bidding-performance claim
weather.features: Temperature, terrestrial and fixed marine-box wind speed, native six-hour mean downward shortwave radiation; mean/spread and named zone contrasts
weather.spatial_support: Common integer-degree nodes, modern 0.5-degree source fields subsampled; fractional projected polygon-area weights; not native one-degree cell averaging
weather.geographic_boundary: Country polygons and fixed marine boxes approximate electrical service areas; marine boxes are not EEZ or capacity-weighted footprints
weather.upgrade_boundary: GEFS upgrade and archive grid changes are disclosed; common members/nodes do not remove model-version changes
weather.unrun_weather_alternatives: Age-60-hour and native-grid alternatives are outside this locked core protocol and are not represented as completed robustness checks

availability_and_fitting.observation_vintages: Historical final/revised provider records; original release vintages are not authenticated
availability_and_fitting.raw_F: Expanding from 2019, quarterly; fit endpoint equals quarter origin minus selected raw holdout days minus nominal seven-day embargo
availability_and_fitting.daily_G: Same quarterly F; rolling selected 30/60-day window with interval END at or before each target day's issue minus seven days, clipped at raw-fit endpoint; minimum 100 valid rows
availability_and_fitting.quarterly_R_and_threshold_cutoff: Quarter origin minus seven days with interval END qualification; this is 6.5 days before the first issue at origin minus 12 hours
availability_and_fitting.dependence_history: Two preceding calendar years of shared forward PITs and named weather features
availability_and_fitting.load_lags: Provider total load at exact target UTC hour minus 14 and 21 days, source interval END plus seven days at or before issue; six linear shared-F features appended after the original 69
availability_and_fitting.lag_vintage_boundary: Revised labels under the declared availability assumption; not certified historical data vintages
availability_and_fitting.test_parameter_updates: Only legally available past observations may update quarterly F/R/threshold and daily G under the locked strategy; no tuning on held-out scores

events.physical_threshold: Selected quarterly past-only adaptive seasonal quantile with slow trend, same-hour daily Fourier structure and three-calendar-year history; no weather covariate in threshold
events.primary: At least two of three zones exceed their issued q90 thresholds in the same UTC hour
events.operator: strict greater than; equality is false
events.physical_secondary: q95, all-three events and the three fixed zone-pair projections of the same fitted three-zone distribution
events.constant_V_diagnostics: PIT u90/u95 at-least-two and all-three events, explicitly separate from physical threshold warnings
events.unknown_label: If any of the three observations or relevant issued thresholds is unavailable, event remains NaN even for a pair projection

comparisons.same_margins: Every comparator consumes exactly the same issued recalibrated F/G and physical-threshold CDF table; conditional calibration uncertainty is shared and reported
core: C4 static t sharing C2 R
C5 dynamic t sharing C3 R
additional: C9 positive monotone recalibration of C3 event probabilities
comparisons.primary_contrast: C5_dynamic_t_shared_R minus C3_dynamic_gaussian on physical q90 at-least-two Brier
comparisons.t_degrees_of_freedom: 3, 5, 8, 15, 30, infinity; choose by past-only pseudo-likelihood, retain exact Gaussian infinity boundary
comparisons.C7: Four member weather variables with all 30 common deterministic calendar and provider-holiday fields in a separate table; fit a past-only rank template and apply its ranks to shared recalibrated F; calendar includes no observed load lag and does not enter R(X) or C8
comparisons.C8: 50 prior analogs using the selected common weather basis and shared forward PITs
comparisons.C9: Uses earlier-quarter C3 forecasts from the same 2022-2025 runner chain; top-K ranking must alias C3 exactly
comparisons.no_model_specific_missingness: Known common-feature eligibility controls forecast rows; an eligible numerical probability failure is fatal

numerics.interpretation: Reported integration discrepancy is a convergence diagnostic, not a rigorous mathematical probability error bound

evaluation.Brier: Equal weight to complete 24-known-label UTC days; identical row and day set across compared models
evaluation.primary_uncertainty: Paired 14-calendar-day resampling with year-quarter strata, 2000 repetitions
evaluation.reliability: Fixed bins from the adapter contract; pointwise calendar-block intervals
evaluation.alert_budget: Top 1, 2 or 4 hourly warnings within each issued target day; primary K=2; deterministic UTC-time tie break
evaluation.monitoring: Hour misses and false alerts; event-spell any-hit, first-day and first-six-elapsed-hour detection, with issuance/onset lead definitions kept distinct
evaluation.spells: Active event days joined across one observed empty day; gap 0/2 sensitivities; missing days break spells and uncertain boundaries are reported separately
evaluation.meteorological_independence_boundary: Spells are event-process proxies, not independently certified weather systems; repeated hours are not independent findings
evaluation.minimum_gain_interpretation: A planning benchmark chosen before test scores, not a guaranteed effect, an established industry threshold or proof of operator utility
evaluation.primary_direction: Negative C5-C3 Brier difference favors C5; report effect, interval and calibration/monitoring together
evaluation.secondary_inference: All other products, contrasts, years, dependence degrees of freedom, monitoring and sensitivity summaries are descriptive pointwise evidence; no simultaneous family or Holm-adjusted claim

measurement_sensitivity.night_PV_scaling: BE hourly net load minus 1 or 5 MW times the number of flagged original reconstructed quarters divided by four
measurement_sensitivity.RTE: Original half-hour timestamps shifted jointly by minus/plus 30 minutes with complete two-reading hourly aggregation and unchanged other zones
measurement_sensitivity.claim: Fixed issued forecasts under alternative observation conventions; label-only changes under unchanged primary thresholds, probabilities, models, ranking and evaluation window; no whole-pipeline refit claim

reproducibility.storage: Immutable raw sources on F; scripts, feature caches, training, checkpoints and results on D
reproducibility.AI_use: Research design, literature retrieval, code, validation, analysis and manuscript assistance; actual usage disclosed without claiming AI was limited to language polishing
reproducibility.publication_evidence: Only verified numerical outputs support empirical claims; no synthetic result is presented as European observed evidence
